description: The steps to appeal a Minnesota property assessment for one county: who to call first (the assessor's phone and page), the county's own steps, open book and Local Board dates, the County Board and the Tax Court deadline, each with its official source, and what evidence boards weigh (recorded sales of similar homes). Use for 'how do I appeal my property taxes', 'how do I contest my assessment', 'who do I call about my property value', 'what do I bring to the board of appeal'. Minnesota only; county steps for Hennepin (Minneapolis), Ramsey, Anoka, Dakota, Scott and Washington.

county.description: Optional: a Minnesota county or 'Minneapolis', e.g. 'Ramsey'
